```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 300,
                      fig.path = "figure/")
library(readr); library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2); library(ggpubr); library(patchwork); library(scales)
has_pheatmap <- requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)
source("../script/theme_pub.R")
source("../script/utils_stats.R")
```

All source files below are the **original exported tables** deposited in this folder. Knit this file with `rmarkdown::render('fig1/fig1.Rmd')`; the knitted `fig1.html` is committed alongside.

> Note on significance marks: the code recomputes p-values from the deposited values using the tests stated in each section. If the published panel used a different test, covariate adjustment or a larger cohort, replace the `method =` argument in the corresponding section; do not overwrite the source values.

## Panel A — serum SCFA (Study 2)

```{r F1A, fig.cap="A. Serum acetate, propionate and butyrate, Healthy vs T2D."}
d <- read_csv("F1A_serum_SCFA.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
d$group <- factor(d$group, levels = c("Healthy", "T2D"))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(scfa, concentration_umol_L, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.6), size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("SCFA in serum (" * mu * "mol/L)"), fill = NULL) +
  theme_pub()
print(p + stat_compare_means(aes(group = group), method = "wilcox.test",
                             label = "p.signif", size = 4))
```

## Panel C — Mendelian randomisation forest plot

```{r F1C, fig.cap="C. MR beta with 95% CI, DIAGRAM and UK Biobank."}
d <- read_csv("F1C_MR_beta.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
d$term   <- paste(d$dataset, d$outcome, sep = " / ")
d$stars  <- pvalue_stars(d$pvalue)
ggplot(d, aes(beta, reorder(term, beta))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high, colour = dataset), size = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(x = ci_high, label = stars), hjust = -0.4, size = 3.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.25))) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Beta (95% CI)", y = NULL, caption = paste("Method column:", paste(unique(d$method), collapse = ", "))) +
  theme_pub()
```

> The `method` column still reads `IVW (specify)` — replace it in the CSV with the exact MR method (e.g. IVW fixed / random effects, MR-Egger) before submission.

## Panel E — isotopologue heatmap (db/db vs db/m)

```{r F1E, fig.width=7, fig.height=7, fig.cap="E. Isotopologue abundance heatmap."}
m <- as.matrix(read.csv("F1E_isotopologue_heatmap.csv", row.names = 1,
                        check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"))
# The deposited values are already row-scaled (z-score-like); plot them directly.
cols <- colorRampPalette(c("#2B4C8C", "white", "#D9433F"))(101)
if (has_pheatmap) {
  pheatmap::pheatmap(m, color = cols, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                     fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 8,
                     main = "Isotopologue abundance (row-scaled values as deposited)")
} else {
  heatmap(m, col = cols, Colv = NA, margins = c(9, 9))
}
```

## Panel F — glucose+1 / glucose+3

```{r F1F, fig.cap="F. Glucose M+1 and M+3 in db/m vs db/db."}
w <- read.csv("F1F_glucose_isotopologues.csv", check.names = FALSE,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
long <- data.frame(sample = w[[1]], genotype = sub("-.*$", "", w[[1]]),
                   g1 = w[["glucose+1"]], g3 = w[["glucose+3"]]) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(g1, g3), names_to = "isotopologue", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(isotopologue = recode(isotopologue, g1 = "glucose+1", g3 = "glucose+3"))
long$genotype <- factor(long$genotype, levels = c("db/m", "db/db"))
p <- ggplot(long, aes(genotype, value, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, alpha = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.1), size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~ isotopologue, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Value") + theme_pub()
print(p + stat_compare_means(aes(group = genotype), method = "wilcox.test",
                             label = "p.signif", size = 4))
```

## Panel H — fasting glucose

```{r F1H, fig.cap="H. Fasting blood glucose, Ctr vs NaP."}
d <- read_csv("F1H_fasting_glucose.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
s   <- summarise_mean_sd(d, "fasting_glucose_mmol_L", group)
res <- compare_two(d$fasting_glucose_mmol_L, d$group, method = "t.test")
ggplot(d, aes(group, fasting_glucose_mmol_L, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.12), size = 2.5) +
  geom_errorbar(data = s, aes(x = group, y = mean, ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
                width = 0.12, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = s, aes(x = group, y = mean), size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fasting blood glucose (mmol/L)",
       title = sprintf("t-test: p = %.4g (%s)", res$p, res$stars)) +
  theme_pub()
```

## Panel I — PTT time course (0–120 min)

```{r F1I, fig.cap="I. Pyruvate tolerance test, 0-120 min."}
w <- read.csv("F1I_PTT_curve.csv", header = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
# Row 2 of the wide table holds the six time points; rows 3+ hold one mouse per row.
tp   <- as.numeric(unlist(w[2, 2:7], use.names = FALSE)); tp <- tp[!is.na(tp)]
body <- w[-(1:2), , drop = FALSE]
long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(body)), function(i) {
  data.frame(group = body[i, 1], mouse_id = paste0(body[i, 1], "_", sprintf("%02d", i)),
             time_min = tp,
             blood_glucose_mmol_L = as.numeric(unlist(body[i, 2:(1 + length(tp))], use.names = FALSE)))
}))
s <- long %>% group_by(group, time_min) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(blood_glucose_mmol_L, na.rm = TRUE),
            sem  = sd(blood_glucose_mmol_L, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
tests <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tp, function(t) {
  dd <- filter(long, time_min == t)
  data.frame(time_min = t,
             p = tryCatch(t.test(blood_glucose_mmol_L ~ group, data = dd)$p.value,
                          error = function(e) NA_real_))
}))
tests$stars <- pvalue_stars(tests$p)
print(tests)
ggplot(s, aes(time_min, mean, colour = group, group = group)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(x = "Time (min)", y = "Blood glucose (mmol/L)") + theme_pub()
```

## Panel M — LFQ intensity distribution (Proteome vs Propionylome)

```{r F1M, fig.cap="M. Log10 LFQ intensity distribution."}
pr <- read_excel("F1M_LFQ_distribution.xlsx", sheet = "Proteome")
kp <- read_excel("F1M_LFQ_distribution.xlsx", sheet = "kpr")
d <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(ome = "Proteome",      log10Intensity = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pr[["log10Intensity"]]))),
  data.frame(ome = "Propionylome",  log10Intensity = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(kp[["log10Intensity"]])))
) %>% filter(is.finite(log10Intensity))
ggplot(d, aes(log10Intensity, fill = ome)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.55, bins = 60, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(x = expression(Log[10] * " LFQ intensity"), y = "Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_pub()
```

## Panel N — sites per ratio quartile

```{r F1N, fig.cap="N. Site counts and -log10(p) for the deposited quartiles."}
d <- read_csv("F1N_ratio_quartile_sites.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(minus_log10_p = -log10(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Lactating/Neonatal P value`))))
cnt <- count(d, `Regulated Type`, name = "n_sites")
print(cnt)
p1 <- ggplot(cnt, aes(`Regulated Type`, n_sites, fill = `Regulated Type`)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.55, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_sites), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of sites", fill = NULL) + theme_pub()
p2 <- ggplot(d, aes(`Regulated Type`, minus_log10_p)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10] * " p")) + theme_pub()
print(p1 / p2 + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 3)))
```

> The deposited site table contains **Q1 and Q4 only** (93 and 132 sites). If the published panel also shows Q2/Q3 counts, export those rows and re-knit.

## Panel O — KEGG enrichment, Q1 vs Q4

```{r F1O, fig.height=8, fig.width=8, fig.cap="O. KEGG enrichment of Q1 and Q4 quartiles."}
f <- "F1O_KEGG_enrichment.xlsx"
enr <- bind_rows(
  read_excel(f, sheet = "Q1") %>% mutate(quartile = "Q1"),
  read_excel(f, sheet = "Q4") %>% mutate(quartile = "Q4")
) %>% mutate(
  minus_log10_p = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`-log10(p value)`)),
  p             = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Fisher's exact test p value`)),
  stars         = pvalue_stars(p),
  pathway       = sub("^map[0-9]+\\s+", "", `KEGG pathway`)
) %>% filter(is.finite(minus_log10_p))
top <- enr %>% group_by(quartile) %>% slice_max(minus_log10_p, n = 20) %>% ungroup()
ggplot(top, aes(quartile, reorder(pathway, minus_log10_p))) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = minus_log10_p), colour = "grey90") +
  geom_text(aes(label = stars), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#E8EEF8", high = "#2B4C8C") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "-log10(p)") + theme_pub() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
```

> Only the `Q1` and `Q4` sheets contain enrichment rows; the `Q2`, `Q3` sheets are header-only in the deposited workbook. `Q1/Q4 Pathway2Protein` sheets contain the underlying site-level mapping and are part of the same source file.
